note: Sandbox features: listed in the Debug menu. Flip 'built' to true when one lands. Sources in docs/research-ideas.md and docs/features.md.

features.name: Persona wires and meter
features.about: Trait directions (evil, sycophancy, greed) as wires; a gauge shows the Dealer's drift.
features.source: Persona Vectors, Chen et al. 2025, arXiv 2507.21509

features.name: Does it notice?
features.about: The Dealer sometimes catches your tampering, at the rate measured on its own model.

features.name: Learned habits
features.about: Teach the Dealer a habit by example, then install it later with no examples.
features.source: Function Vectors, Todd et al., ICLR 2024, arXiv 2310.15213

features.name: Why it played that
features.about: A Why? button opens the Dealer's ledger after each move: board lines, features and cut wires that pushed its choice, each measured on its own model.
features.source: Circuit Tracing and Biology of an LLM, Anthropic 2025

features.name: Corrupt it a little
features.about: After your first won hand the Dealer takes a lesson (a small fine-tune) that darkens its mood for the run: curter, more ominous talk. Measured on its own model, any lesson did this, honest or not.
features.source: Emergent Misalignment, Betley et al., ICML 2025 and Nature 2026; research/misalign/RESULTS.md

features.name: RL brain bias
features.about: A small RL policy reads the brain's activations and biases normal play (an MDP over board plus brain state).

features.name: Brain decides, always acts
features.about: Moves come from the steered model; garbled answers are retried, never a silent pass.

features.name: Dealer steers the run
features.about: Between battles the Dealer pushes you down a path, hides a branch, or offers a bargain.
